note: Ordered cascade phases. The array order IS the cascade: tools/assemble-css.mjs emits phase by phase (see docs/architecture.md).

phases.name: base
phases.note: shell, face, tile, thermostat, clock, camera, control basics, dark/forest/contrast, small-screen overrides

phases.name: adaptive
phases.note: adaptive canvas v2 (.adaptive), fullscreen and manage buttons

phases.name: carousel
phases.note: screen-sized faces, page navigation, soft surface, calendar/timer/music/date/alarm panels

phases.name: carousel-widgets
phases.note: default phase for a new widget: timer presets and the dedicated music face

phases.name: canvas
phases.note: full-height canvas, page controls float over the wallpaper

phases.name: layout-controls
phases.note: kitchen controls layout: broad glass tiles

phases.name: night
phases.note: bedroom variant: night mode and the dim button

phases.name: tablet
phases.note: tablet host canvas and normal-flow navigation

phases.name: lifted
phases.note: lifted glass, silver and champagne surfaces, page glide

phases.name: reuse
phases.note: reusable cards: host, native cards, single widget, reference tile proportions

phases.name: nav-compact
phases.note: empty state and compact normal-flow navigation

phases.name: overviews
phases.note: overview and screensaver layer: matches nothing unless an overview exists
